UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Learner profile, XP, and completed beginner English lessons.

lastLessonId.description: Most recently practiced lesson ID so the learner can resume across sessions.

dailyGoal.description: User-selected daily message practice goal (e.g., 5, 10, or 20 messages).

currentStreak.description: Consecutive calendar days of app usage.

longestStreak.description: Longest consecutive days streak achieved by the user.

lastActiveDate.description: Most recent active local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

dailyStudyMinutesGoal.description: User-selected daily English learning time goal in minutes (e.g., 10, 20, or 30).

todayStudySeconds.description: Total active study session seconds logged for lastStudyDate.

lastStudyDate.description: Local calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) for which todayStudySeconds was recorded.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether daily English practice reminder notifications are enabled.

lastDailyQuizDate.description: Local calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the 5-question flashcard quiz was completed.

lastDailyQuizScore.description: Most recent daily quiz score out of 5.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

VocabItem.title: VocabItem
VocabItem.description: Saved English vocabulary word or phrase with Arabic translation and phonetic guide.

phoneticArabic.description: Approximate pronunciation written in Arabic script.

phoneticEnglish.description: IPA transcription and beginner syllable phonetic spelling (e.g. /ˈkɒfi/ • KAW-fee).

category.description: Topic category such as Greetings, Pronunciation, or Tutor.

mastered.description: Whether the learner marked this word as mastered.

usageCount.description: Frequency count of how many times this word appeared in user conversations.

TutorTurn.title: TutorTurn
TutorTurn.description: Saved written or vocal AI English tutor practice exchange.

userInput.description: Learner text input or speech transcription.

arabicTranslation.description: Arabic translation of the teacher response.

feedbackArabic.description: Grammar or pronunciation guidance in Arabic.

/users/{userId}.description: Learner profile and lesson progress document.

/users/{userId}/tutor_turns/{turnId}.description: Persisted written and vocal AI tutor conversation turns.
